text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: billing-metering.token_count_drift > 18% for prod-ingest (affected customers: ~52). Alert rule: token-count-delta-high. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2125001234

alex: I'm on call. Acknowledge. digging in now. who owns the counting pipeline?

maya: billing here. we saw a cluster of overage flags hit the billing queue ~06:12 UTC. looks correlated to recent shard config change on ingest-aggregator yesterday.

sam: grabbing recent counts. quick query:```
SELECT hour, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_aggregates
WHERE hour >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour desc
LIMIT 12;
```

sam: output (sanitized):```
2026-11-03T06:00Z | 1,240,123,412
2026-11-03T05:00Z | 1,042,321,002
2026-11-03T04:00Z |   812,332,900
```

sam: that's a ~20-25% jump vs expected baseline for this window.

natalie: billing-bot shows ~48 customers flagged for provisional overages (auto-notify enabled). we should pause auto-notify until we confirm. /cc @maya

maya: agreed, can we pause the overage-notify job? url: https://redwood.internal/jobs/overage-notify

alex: running pause now. `curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/jobs/overage-notify/pause -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'`

incident-bot: job pause request received by ops-api (req-id: req_0a7c).

jordan: oncall-sre here. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering/token-drift. Steps 1-3 are triage and fallback.

alex: initial triage: ingest-aggregator shard 7 had a mis-applied rolling window config (`window_size=60s` -> `window_size=6s`), causing duplicate token buckets to be emitted. rolling back config now.

sam: can you paste the exact config diff?

alex:```
- "window_size": "6s"
+ "window_size": "60s"
```

alex: rollback applied to staging at 06:28 UTC, and to prod shard 7 at 06:33 UTC.

maya: billing-bot: unflag customers that had provisional overage within the noisy window? we shouldn't bill customers for bad data.

billing-bot: Received unflag request. Creating ticket BL-212500 for manual recon and backfill.

natalie: CSMs notified for top 10 revenue customers (email batch queued). recommend holding invoices for the impacted window.

jordan: monitoring: token delta metric now trending back to baseline — see graph link. setting 15m watch.

alex: quick sanity check: re-run same SQL for the last 3 hours post-rollback.```
SELECT hour, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_aggregates
WHERE hour >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour desc;
```

sam: post-rollback output:```
2026-11-03T06:00Z | 1,043,212,100
2026-11-03T05:00Z |   825,334,900
2026-11-03T04:00Z |   811,900,200
```

sam: looks back to expected shape, ~<3% drift now.

alex: severity: we dropped from P1 -> P2 for ongoing ops work, but billing team requested manual recon.

maya: owning customer impact assessment. preliminary: 52 customers flagged, estimated potential overcount ~3.4M tokens total across those flags, most under billing thresholds but 4 customers above threshold.

natalie: CSMs will reach out to the 4 customers directly with the update. drafting a short note: "We observed a brief metering issue from 06:12-06:33 UTC. We've paused automated overage notifications and will reconcile your usage. No charges will be posted until we've validated the backfill."

alex: mitigation checklist: 1) rollback config ✅ 2) pause overage notifications ✅ 3) open BL-212500 for recon & backfill ✅ 4) schedule backfill job (non-peak) ✅

jordan: can we add an automated assert to the pipeline to detect window_size drift? put it on my plate post-incident.

alex: oncall handoff in 20m — @jordan will pick up monitoring; @sam will own reconciliation job; @maya owns customer comms and final billing decision.

sam: starting backfill job now (dry-run). command: `python tools/backfill_tokens.py --start "2026-11-03T06:00Z" --end "2026-11-03T06:33Z" --dry-run`

sam: dry-run results: predicted delta -3,412,102 tokens (i.e., we should subtract this many duplicates).

maya: recommendation: subtract duplicates and unflag customers; credits for any erroneously billed overages. I'll escalate for approvals.

natalie: creating incident page and assigning postmortem owner: @alex. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2125001234/page

alex: acknowledgement. I'll own postmortem and RCA. oncall handoff to jordan in 10m.

incident-bot: Reminder: create a postmortem within 72h and tag with billing, metering, and runbook updates.

jordan: taking handoff. monitoring watch set. will run the assert automation ticket after stabilization.

alex: wrapping: mitigation verified, provisional overages paused, backfill planned and approved for midnight UTC, CSMs notified, postmortem assigned. closing live incident thread, moving to follow-up. :white_check_mark:
